items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Papa Celestan? Did he rank with the very best in those days? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, yeah, Papa did. He shared. But Papa, I mean, was a different type, too.

ctx.x: Well, Chris Kelly, he was more of a blues trumpet player. In fact, he was one of the best blues trumpets to play their head around here.
What about Papa Celestan? Did he rank with the very best in those days? Was he one of the great players?

Well, yeah, Papa did. He shared. But Papa, I mean, was a different type, too. I mean, that's another type of trumpet. Papa was more of a sweet, sweet type. He had numbers he featured, like Josephine, whenever you launch some telephone to me, well, I mean, he used to specialize.
